functions.name: listAccounts
functions.description: List all Thunderbird mail accounts available for OAuth2 token refresh.

functions.name: getAccessToken
functions.description: Get a fresh OAuth2 access token using Thunderbird's built-in OAuth2 module. If hostname is omitted, auto-detects from the user's existing mail accounts, falling back to 'outlook.office365.com' for M365.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname of the mail server. If omitted, auto-detected from the username.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (email address) of the account

functions.name: detectAccount
functions.description: Auto-detect OAuth2 server config from Thunderbird's existing mail accounts by matching the email address.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address to match against existing account usernames
